notes.title: The Fear Business is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's been a long journey, but we're greatly pleased to announce that you can play The Fear Business now!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42882830/5dc27c288d99dddace4133a5e821d7c689e8aa65.png

In the past, you tricked the scissors killer on The Night of the Scissors, you managed to escape from the Tucker farm on Cannibal Abduction. Now it's time to dust off your camcorder and meet our deadliest killer to the date, Goat Face awaits on this thrilling survival horror story inspired by iconic found footage movies.
Game features

 Experience the fear of being locked with the deadly Goat Face.
 Find places to hide... Or fight back, if you dare.
 Interview Black Hill's locals and record as much footage as you can in the free view first person mode.
 A huge victorian manor to explore, every room is full of interactions, items to collect, things to record, secrets and puzzles.
 Blow the candles that light the devil shrines for saving your progress, but there's a catch... The manor will become darker every time you do it!
 Cinematic camera angles and authentic VHS glitches.
 Learn about the Architect's secrets and discover an incredible plot twist!
 Contemplate the most horrific creations in an ingame gallery art. Every piece you see was painted by real horror artists!
 The game is available for Windows, MacOS and SteamOS/Linux.

What's coming next?
First, we're going to patch bugs and add/improve translations. We might roll a content patch in the future.

notes.content:
New:

Added D-Pad keybinding for moving.

Other:

Fixed an issue that could cause a hardlock if the killer caught Adam while a collected item was on the screen.
Refresh achievement progress every time a new game is started. This is to prevent getting achievements by doing them partially and restarting.

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Get ready for some treat hunting!

Play The Night of the Scissors from October 25th to October 31st to find all the treats and get a special seasonal achievement. Keep in mind that if you miss the event, you will have to wait until next year Halloween season to get the achievement!

Good luck returning to the Snipper's hideout!

Changelog
New:

 Added Halloween event during the spooky week.
 Added seasonal killer Halloween custome.
 Added seasonal collectable Halloween treats.
 Added seasonal Halloween achievement.

Other:

 Added missing Spanish translation.

notes.title: Collect treats and earn a seasonal achievement!
notes.content:
Are you ready to celebrate the spooky season?!

We'll be rolling an update that adds an in-game Halloween event. The Snipper is ready to strike back once again, this time, with a special seasonal disguise!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42314560/1a9cb8617ee9e9ed4c04a00d330f1e5e85190953.gif

Play the game during October 25th to October 31st to activate the special Halloween event and get the seasonal achievement by finding the hidden treats spread across the Snipper hideout!

notes.title: Multi-language update
notes.content:
We're proud to present you the patch 1.2.0 for The Night of the Scissors, which includes one of the most demanded features, language localization.

List of official translations:

Spanish
Portuguese
German
French
Finnish

Changelog
New:

 Added localization support
 Added auto detect language feature (if language is available, based on your system language)
 Added language selector to the settings screen
 Added custom localization support

Non official translations/Custom localization
One thing to point out, is that there's also support for non-official translations, if your language isn't available for the game, you can be the first to add the translation!

Under the "/The Night of the Scissors_Data/StreamingAssets/Translations" directory you will find easy to follow instructions in order to add your own custom translation by editing a file.

Community
One minor thing I'd like to share is the creation of a Discord server for The Night of the Scissors and every game published by selewi. Join us and say hello!

notes.title: The Night of the Scissors out now on STEAM!
notes.content:
After the successful release on other small stores, I'm pleased to present you an updated version of the slasher survival horror game where a crazy maniac wielding a pair of scissors haunts you.

Don't get caught!
